title: Ledger wallet app data
whyItMatters: Ledger's desktop app stores account names, settings and caches in app.json. It shows which accounts were tracked, though keys stay on the device.
source: Ledger support: user data under macOS Library/Application Support/Ledger Wallet - https://support.ledger.com/article/8490479490333-zd
notes: Glob covers the current 'Ledger Wallet' folder and the older 'Ledger Live' name. app.json is never opened; the recovery phrase is not on disk here.

steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup for the device, and that the device still restores from it.
Quit the Ledger app so its files are not in use.
Delete the Ledger folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Account names and settings leave this Mac. The coins stay on the hardware device and come back with its phrase.
cleanup.source: Ledger, How to fully uninstall Ledger Wallet (formerly Ledger Live): https://support.ledger.com/article/7643373623453-zd
